_env_note: Service LOCATION is env-overridable in one place (harness-audit F6): set ARAG_HOME / MACRORAG_HOME (host repo roots), MCP_PYTHON (interpreter), or RAGINFER_URL (shared inference svc) in the environment; the ${VAR:-default} values below assume ARag (XbrlRag) and MacroRAG are checked out next to this repo and that `python` on PATH is the py312 interpreter.

arag.note: ARag fundamentals (SEC 10-K/Q). The runnable entry is `python -m src.mcp_server.server` (cwd=ARag); ARag has no __main__.py and no argparse, so --transport/--tenant from the original block are dropped and transport is set via ARAG_MCP_TRANSPORT (tenant is a no-op for ARag).

macro.note: MacroRAG macro factors + citation-gated shock vectors. --tenant scenariogen scopes retrieval (currently the shared corpus).

_note_timeouts: Per tool (spec mcp-call-timeouts): a call gets its tool_timeouts_s entry, else call_timeout_s; a tool that times out degrade_after_timeouts times is skipped for the rest of the run, other tools on its server keep working. Every call timeout must be <= timeout_s. Synthesize (retrieval + LLM synthesis) exceeded 300s in a live run, hence 900s.
_note_macro_names: MacroRAG's tools are themselves named macro_* (e.g. macro_query), so the server-prefixed names are macro__macro_query etc. ARag tools are bare, so arag__coverage etc.
